name: Book: Stresses of Iron
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Margulf Blaggon’s book on metallurgy has been lent to Northshire Abbey for copying.

sections.title: A Borrowed Volume
sections.body: Margulf Blaggon wrote about the practical and theoretical sides of metallurgy. Milton Sheaf cared for the volume in the Royal Library of Stormwind Keep. The library lent it to Northshire Abbey, where Brother Paxton copied it by hand for his own collection. Paxton’s work took far longer than expected, and Brother Kristoff waited anxiously in Cathedral Square for the book to return to the city.

faq.answer: Margulf Blaggon’s book covers metallurgy and metalworking, in both theory and practice.

faq.q: Why was the book at Northshire Abbey?
faq.answer: Brother Paxton borrowed the book from Stormwind’s Royal Library to copy it by hand for his own collection before returning the original.
Brother Kristoff wanted the book returned. Waiting in Cathedral Square, he urgently asked for it, and an adventurer traced its whereabouts between the Royal Library and Northshire.

angles.text: Margulf Blaggon’s book explores iron’s strengths and the practical limits of working with it.
